title: ticket sellers
description: this mod adds a shop block and a ticket block. the ticket block will allow you to "open" iron doors without redstone.
body: this is a mod that adds to new items: the shop and the ticket. the shop allows whoever first opens it to be able to get diamonds form it when ever someone else pays to get a ticket. the ticket allows you to "open" iron doors with a simple right click. it will take your ticket though.
